newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Goh to tour southern Africa.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Goh to tour southern Africa.

text.p: Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong will start a tour of southern Africa on Monday, beginning with a four-day visit to South Africa and talks with President Nelson Mandela.
Goh's office said in a statement on Friday Goh would also meet Deputy President Thabo Mbeki, widely considered Mandela's likely successor, in Cape Town.
The Singapore leader would also visit Robben Island, where Mandela was imprisoned for more than 20 years under the previous white-led apartheid regime.
Goh's office said he would then pay a three-day visit from February 28 to March 2 to Zimbabwe, where he would hold talks with President Robert Mugabe.
He would then meet President Sam Nujoma in Windhoek during a visit to Namibia from March 2 to March 4, and go on to Gaborone for talks with Botswana's President Ketumile Masire.
